# Security

Please report vulnerabilities privately: **Security → Report a vulnerability** on this repository
([the form](https://github.com/wormhole-terminal/wormhole-vt/security/advisories/new)). Don't open a
public issue for it. What to include, what counts and what the engine guarantees are in
[crates/wormhole-vt/SECURITY.md](../crates/wormhole-vt/SECURITY.md).
